A series of six '''Sith artifacts''' were used as power sources by the [[SV-3 Eradicator]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] aboard the ''[[Red Reaper]]''. The Eradicator accessed the [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] via [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] on the ''Reaper''{{'s}} bridge, and aligning the artifacts generated massive amounts of power for the droid.
